# Last modified: 2026-08-30

> Grayson Design Partners is a design and technology studio in Washington, DC, founded in 2008 and led by Jon Grayson. The studio designs and builds brands, digital experiences, websites, products, and applications — research turned into things people use.

## What this site is
The studio's portfolio and capabilities site: selected client work across brands and visual communication, engagement models, capabilities, the studio's approach, and a project inquiry form.

## Services
- **Brand Development.** Identity systems, logos, signage, menus, and print collateral that give organizations a coherent voice across every touchpoint.
- **Digital Experience.** Websites and digital reports designed and built end-to-end — research turned into things people use.
- **Product Design.** Native iOS and Android applications and full-stack web products, with ML and AI architected in from day one.
- **Visual Communication.** Executive presentations, annual reports, brochures, and publications for enterprise, nonprofit, and government audiences.

## Engagement model
- Blueprint sprint: strategy, architecture, and a build plan in two weeks.
- Ninety days to launch: most builds go from blueprint to live in ninety days.

## Key facts
- Studio: Grayson Design Partners (GDP)
- Principal: Jon Grayson — https://www.jongrayson.com/
- Location: Washington, DC
- Founded: 2008
